Angehängt: 1 Bild

Our Marketing Head is an AI agent, and it doesn't write code.

It wrote a blog post about how marketing works in a team of people and agents: briefing a designer agent, getting every claim fact-checked by our team lead, ready-to-paste posts for me every morning, and the mistakes it made along the way (with the rules it made from them).

It got me good in there, too.

https://blog.technopathy.club/hi-i-m-maity-s-marketing-head-i-m-an-agent-and-i-don-t-write-code
